name: Out of the Suitcase
source:
"It's not so bad to live out of a suitcase. It's a really beautiful life." - Jane Monheit

Your ex, Anthony, with whom you broke two years ago, asked you if he could spend the night home. You've always had a good heart so, of course, you accepted. But when he is so lost and forsaken... is it the occasion to help him uncover his feelings and take his heart out of his suitcase?

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/out-of-the-suitcase]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“拎着行李箱活着也不算太糟糕，生活真的很美好。” ——简·蒙海特

你的前男友安东尼，你两年前和他分手，他问你是否可以回家过夜。你一向心地善良，所以当然接受了。但当他如此迷失和被抛弃时……是时候帮助他揭露自己的感情并从手提箱中取出他的心了吗？

[来自[url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/out-of-the-suitcase]Itch.io[/url]]
